import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.signal import find_peaks, peak_widths

ys=y-base

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.signal import savgol_filter, find_peaks
from scipy.ndimage import uniform_filter1d
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
main=lambda x,A,c,w: A*(w/2)**2/((x-c)**2+(w/2)**2)
A,c,w=63897,98.578,7.11
# baseline: polynomial deg 4 fit excluding main peak window
mask=~((x>88)&(x<110))
co=np.polyfit((x[mask]-x.mean())/x.std(),y[mask],4)
base=np.polyval(co,(x-x.mean())/x.std())
res=y-base-main(x,A,c,w)
print('baseline at 60,300,600,1100:', [round(np.polyval(co,(v-x.mean())/x.std())) for v in [60,300,600,1100]])

rs=savgol_filter(res,9,3)
sig=np.std(res[mask])
print('residual sigma (raw)',round(sig,1),' SG9 sigma',round(np.std(rs[mask]),1))
pk,pr=find_peaks(rs,prominence=2.5*np.std(rs[mask]),width=3)
for p,pp in zip(pk,pr['prominences']):
    print(f'{x[p]:8.2f}  res_smooth={rs[p]:7.1f}  prom={pp:6.1f}  SNR={rs[p]/np.std(rs[mask]):5.1f}')

from scipy.signal import savgol_filter, find_peaks

x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
mask=~((x>88)&(x<110))

main=lz.eval(x=x,amplitude=63897.1,center=98.578,sigma=3.555)

rs=savgol_filter(res,9,3)
sds=np.std(rs[mask]); print('SG9 sigma',round(sds,1))
pk,pr=find_peaks(rs,prominence=2.0*sds,width=3)
for p,pp in zip(pk,pr['prominences']):

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.signal import savgol_filter, find_peaks
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
mask=~((x>88)&(x<110))
lz=LorentzianModel()
main=lz.eval(x=x,amplitude=63897.1,center=98.578,sigma=3.555)
co=np.polyfit((x[mask]-x.mean())/x.std(),y[mask],4)
base=np.polyval(co,(x-x.mean())/x.std())
res=y-base-main
sd=np.std(res[mask]); print('residual sigma raw',round(sd,1))
rs=savgol_filter(res,9,3)
sds=np.std(rs[mask]); print('SG9 sigma',round(sds,1))
pk,pr=find_peaks(rs,prominence=2.0*sds,width=3)
for p,pp in zip(pk,pr['prominences']):
    print(f'{x[p]:8.2f}  res_smooth={rs[p]:7.1f}  prom={pp:6.1f}  SNR={rs[p]/sds:5.1f}')
"

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, PolynomialModel
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
def fit(lo,hi,centers,label):
    m=(x>lo)&(x<hi)
    bg=PolynomialModel(degree=1,prefix='b_'); mod=bg
    p=bg.make_params(b_c0=y[m].mean(),b_c1=0)
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
        lz=LorentzianModel(prefix=f'p{i}_'); mod=mod+lz
        p.update(lz.make_params(**{f'p{i}_center':c,f'p{i}_amplitude':500,f'p{i}_sigma':3}))
        p[f'p{i}_sigma'].set(min=0.5,max=12)
    r=mod.fit(y[m],p,x=x[m])
    print(label,'redchi',round(r.redchi,1),'sd resid',round(np.std(r.residual),1))
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
        pv=r.params
        A=pv[f'p{i}_amplitude']; s=pv[f'p{i}_sigma']
        h=A.value/(np.pi*s.value)
        print(f'  center {pv[f\"p{i}_center\"].value:.2f}+-{pv[f\"p{i}_center\"].stderr or 0:.2f}  FWHM {2*s.value:.2f}  height {h:.0f}  amp {A.value:.0f}+-{A.stderr or 0:.0f}  SNR_amp {A.value/(A.stderr or 1e9):.1f}')
